EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}If you're gonna shop here, you need
to get something that says 
"GracieGrace" on it in big letters!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}You wanna make sure even people
far away know you're wearing
something cool! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Si vas a comprar aquí, ¡tienes
que pillar algo de la marca
La divina Graciela!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}¡Todos tienen que saber incluso de
lejos que te gusta vestir ropa de la
más chula que hay, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Si t'as les moyens, choisis un truc
avec la marque « Galeries Carla »
bien visible dessus !

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Se hai intenzione di fare compere
in questo negozio, scegli qualcosa
della linea Griffe di Griffa.
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}In questo modo nessuno potrà
fare a meno di notare il tuo
stile, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Wenn du schon hier was kaufst,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
dann kauf was, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}auf dem fett
„Grazias Grazie“ steht!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Dann sehen Leute schon von
Weitem,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} dass du 'n cooles Outfit
anhast! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
